$comment: `reasoning: { effort, budgetTokens }` — both given — is the portable spelling: dialects
with a real token budget (anthropic-messages, gemini) take the budget, dialects without
one (openai-chat) take the effort bucket. Nothing is approximated by that split, so it
warns nowhere; what DOES warn is the bucket itself, since "max" is Anthropic vocabulary
and chat-completions tops out at "high" — see unified-warnings.json.
`providerOptions.anthropic` is the live bucket only when the target IS anthropic, which is
exactly this case's source dialect. Compiled for any other target it is inert and silent,
which is why the pipeline here cannot reproduce to-openai-chat.json's `container` warning.
